title.narrative: Driving Transformational Change to Mitigate Direct and Indirect Mining Impacts on High-Integrity Forests

description.narrative: Completion of at least two advocacy actions at the EU level, with evidence that at least one recommendation on mining impacts or safeguards is being incorporated into EU policies or financial frameworks relating to overseas mining investmentsIn the EU, increasing awareness and capacity of the mining sector (target companies and associations) and policy-makers to apply Mitigation Hierarchy actions, develop pathways to biodiversity no net loss/net gain/nature positive for addressing mining impacts and benefit IP&LCs, especially on impacts on high-integrity forested landscapesTailored knowledge products on mitigation hierarchy, biodiversity no net loss and community engagement produced and accessible to target companies and relevant stakeholders

The Forest Governance, Markets and Climate (“FGMC”) Programme is a global programme of the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (“FCDO”) with the broad aim of strengthening forest stewardship in developing countries by supporting inclusive multistakeholder deliberations on national and international rules, incentivised by market mechanisms and trade regulations. The second phase of the programme (FGMC2) started in 2024.

Knowledge products, policy advocacy briefings and training materials developed for and communicated with policy-makers and industry bodies in consuming/importing/outbound foreign investment countries (EU) to promote the adoption of the mitigation hierarchy framework and biodiversity and forest no net loss, net gain and nature positive approaches within national policies and industry standards to guide overseas investment/operation and/or supply chain management

Number of capacity building and awareness raising events and number of participants in these events (including dialogues, workshops, training events) to discuss biodiversity & forest and/or IP&LC & gender safeguards.

Number of policy briefs, analytical reports, and industry-level standards developed and formally shared with policymakers, institutions, and industry platforms in the EU, explicitly addressing the mitigation hierarchy and biodiversity/forest no net loss and net gain principles
